title: wk AI Tools Budget
desc: Budget rules for cheap-first auto selection and cooldown handling.
steps: AUTO cheap-first order is flash then codex-mini then haiku then mini then sonnet
auto skips models still in cooldown and prefers the first model that returns a first line quickly
Recent failure records use a 30 minute cooldown
Success records stay cached for 30 minutes
Use the cheapest model that still satisfies the task and escalate only when needed
author: claude
